sourcesContent:
## Separate core probe: custom require messages remain in RuleMachine.can with their refusal.
app RuleMachineCore
Given
 Job { title:text="valid", editable:bool=true, status:enum(idle,queued,ready)=idle machine }
 invariant Job: row.title!="forbidden"
 lock Job fields=title when=row.status==ready
 policy Job read=public
When
 crud Job by=public fields=title,editable
 ## Disabled jobs must fail before an invalid stamp is evaluated; neither path may mutate.
 scenario start(job:Job,stamp:text) by=public -> bool
  require job.editable
  require datetime(stamp)<=now
  require job.title!="blocked"
  do
   transition job.status idle -> queued
   require job.status==queued
   transition job.status queued -> ready
   return true
 ## A title change after ready must be refused by the declared lock.
 scenario rename(job:Job,title:text) by=public -> bool
  do
   set job {title}
   return true
 ## This must be refused by the invariant, including any earlier staged changes.
 scenario violate(job:Job) by=public -> bool
  do
   set job {editable=false}
   set job {title="forbidden"}
   return true
 ## The second transition must fail and roll back the first transition.
 scenario rollback(job:Job) by=public -> bool
  do
   transition job.status idle -> queued
   transition job.status idle -> ready
   return true
Then
 page / title="Rules and machines"
  list Job
   text row.title,row.status
